messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

message.content:
營收（Revenue） = 15,000 USD  
總成本（Cost） = 22,000 USD  

**1. 計算淨利潤 (Net Profit)**  
\[
\text{Net Profit} = \text{Revenue} - \text{Cost} = 15{,}000 - 22{,}000 = -7{,}000 \text{ USD}
\]

**2. 計算回報率（Profit Margin）**  
回報率通常指「淨利潤佔營收的比例」，即：

\[
\text{Return Rate} = \frac{\text{Net Profit}}{\text{Revenue}} \times 100\%
= \frac{-7{,}000}{15{,}000} \times 100\%
= -46.67\%
\]

---

### 結論
- **淨利潤**：-7,000 USD  
- **回報率（Profit Margin）**：**-46.7 %**  

這表示該企業在此期間虧損，營收僅覆蓋了約 53.3 % 的成本，剩餘 46.7 % 為虧損。若您想要其他指標（如 ROI = 淨利潤 / 成本），請告訴我！

They gave revenue and cost. Net profit = revenue - cost = -7000. Return rate maybe negative 46.7%? Actually net profit margin = (revenue - cost)/revenue = -7000/15000 = -0.4667 = -46.67%. Or ROI = net profit / cost? That would be -7000/22000 = -0.318 = -31.8%. Usually return rate refers to profit margin. So answer: -46.7%. Provide explanation.
